19
RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the November 20, 2007/Kartika 29, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Foreign visits of officials of Public
Sector Banks
*61. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has issued
directions/guidelines that Chairmen and
Managing Directors of Public Sector Banks
would not undertake foreign visits for more
than ten days in a financial year;
(b) if so, when these directions were
issued and the details thereof;
(c) whether violations of these
directions have come  to Government’s
notice during 2005, 2006 and 2007, so far;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken/proposed to be
taken against the violators?
Strengthening of the financial system
*62. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether USA has offered support
to strengthen and expand India’s financial
system;
(b) if so, whether any dialogue has been
initiated to reach agreement on the issue;
(c) if so, whether developing Mumbai
into an International Finance Centre (IFC)
forms part of the agenda; and
(d) if so, the details of the steps, in
addition to IFC, that are envisaged to be
taken up with USA?
Increase in prices of common consumer
goods
†*63. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn towards the recently published
report by the Price Monitoring Cell of the
concerned department of the  Ministry of
Consumer Affairs indicating therein that
the prices of  fifteen common consumer
goods of daily use have increased by 25
per cent during the last one year only;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(c) the names of the consumer goods
about which study has been conducted and
reported in the said publication?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

20
Guidelines for realizing loans by banks
*64. MS. MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government had issued
guidelines against the Banks whose agents
have allegedly been found harassing the
customers for realizing the loans;
(b) if so, the details of the protection
given to the customers and the agencies
where such complaints for redressal could
be lodged;
(c) whether such guidelines put onus
on the concerned banks; and
(d) if so, what steps have been taken
against the banks in the recent cases of
harassment as reported in the media?
Extension of services of small aircrafts
in Uttarakhand, H.P. and N.E.
†*65. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering to extend the services of small
aircrafts in various parts of the country,
particularly in the States of Uttarakhand,
Himachal Pradesh (H.P.) and North-East
(N.E.) on regular basis;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when these services are likely to
be made operative;
(d) whether it is a fact that private
operators are not interested to introduce
their services in these areas; and
(e) if so, the action being taken by
Government against such operators?
Criteria for price-fixation of gas from
KG basin
*66. SHRI D. RAJA:
SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of  PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether there have been concerns
voiced by certain quarters about the pricing
of natural gas to be extracted from Krishna-
Godavari (KG) basin by Reliance
Industries Ltd.;
(b) if so, what is the criteria adopted in
fixing the prices of natural gas being
extracted by Reliance from KG basin;
and
(c) what is Government’s reaction to the
concerns being expressed by certain
quarters?
Financial assistance for conservation of
monuments in AP
*67. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of CUL TURE be pleased to
state:
(a)   the number of proposals received
in the Ministry from Andhra Pradesh
Government for financial assistance for the
conservation of monuments of historical/
cultural value, indicating the location-wise
details of each project;
(b) the estimated conservation cost of
each monument;
(c) the status of these proposals and
funds allocated/released so far for each of
these monuments; and
(d) the reasons for delay in clearing
these proposals?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

21
Shortage of LPG connections in
Himachal Pradesh
*68. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
shortage of LPG connections in the country
for a long period;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it would be solved;
(c) whether it is also a fact that in the
State of Himachal Pradesh, particula

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for  WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the November 19, 2007/Kartika 28, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Earth Sciences; Food Processing Industries; Human Resource
Development; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable
Energy; Power; Science and Technology; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 79
Electronic measurement of
earthquakes
87. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: W ill the Minister of
EARTH SCIENCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any scheme to set up electronic
system for accurate measurement of
intensity of earthquakes, in the wake of
severe earthquake of October, 2005;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when this system is proposed to
be set up; and
(d) whether it would find out the
earthquakes from the atmospheric and
ocean current?
Instruments/computers for weather
forecasting
88. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the instruments/computers
available for weather forecasting, ocean
information and tropical meteorology are
completely out-dated;
(b) if so, whether Government are
planning to buy/produce super computers
for tracking changes in the climate of the
country;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the funds allocated for the purpose?
Shortage of food processing units in
Rajasthan
89. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is acute
shortage of food processing units in
Rajasthan; and
(b) if so, the incentives Government
plan to give for setting up more such units
in that State?
Grants for food processing industries
in Sikkim
90. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of financial assistance
granted for setting up of food processing

24
industries in the country under various
schemes, particularly in Sikkim; and
(b) the details of amount spent on
setting up of food processing industries in
the country during the last three years,
State-wise?
Objectives of SSA
91. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: W ill the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the objectives of the Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan;
(b) whether these objectives have been
achieved;
(c) if not, how much time has lapsed
between the target dates and today;
(d) the reasons for failure in
achievement of targets;
(e) what percentage of the child
population remains out of school on this
day;
(f) by when these children would be
brought under the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan
Programme;
(g) what steps are being taken to
accelerate the achievement of targets; and
(h) what percentage of funds is being
utilized to achieve these targets?
Setting up of new universities
92. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
 Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to set up 30
new universities for expanding access to
higher education in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the universities that would be set up in
Orissa;
(c) whether it is also proposed to set up
6,000 quality schools, one in each block
of the country, to secure excellence in
public schooling; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, indicating
inter-alia, those that are proposed to be set
up in Orissa?
Education in the National Common
Minimum Programme
93. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:  Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of steps initiated by
Government  to fulfil the promises made
in the National Common Minimum
Programme in regard to education;
(b) whether the Right to Education,
enshrined in the Constitution, has been
fulfilled;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken to provide free and
compulsory education to children?
Expenditure on education
94. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
 Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the percentage of GDP
towards higher education, primary and
middle education during the last three
years;
(b) how it compares with the developed
countries; and

25
(c) whether Government plan to
increase this in the coming years?
High illiteracy rate States
95. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:  Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether eight States alone account
for nearly 70 per cent of the country's
illiterates; which means that out of 304
million illiterate people in the country,
212.19 million come from these eight
States alone;
(b) whether, according to the recently
released reports on the status of adult
literacy in the country, 13 States need to
pay special attention for raising their
literacy levels;
(c) if so, whether this report was
brought out by the National Literacy
Mission; and

measures Governm
